scientific_question: When Upbit publicly announces first-time KRW market support for a token that has already traded on Binance Spot USDT for at least 24 hours, does a positive access/liquidity shock remain exploitable on Binance after a realistic five-minute delay?

economic_mechanism.rationale: A first-time Upbit KRW market adds direct Korean-fiat access and a large exchange-specific demand/liquidity venue to an already price-discovered token. Cross-market segmentation can delay full transmission of the access shock. The experiment tests residual continuation after the public announcement rather than instantaneous reaction or the later Upbit trading-open print.
materially_distinct_from_prior: Not generic price momentum or indicator mining.
Not Binance perpetual launch shock: the causal event is new Korean fiat-market access on another exchange.
Not exchange delisting: the shock is access expansion, not forced access removal.
Not generic cross-venue lead-lag: the event is a public, timestamped structural listing announcement.

official_event_source.pagination_rule: Pagination may traverse current/recent announcement-list metadata only to reach the frozen 2023-2024 window. Out-of-window titles/bodies must not be serialized into evidence. No 2025/2026 market prices may be opened.

parser_contract.pattern_A: One or more title segments NAME(SYMBOL)(MARKET-LIST containing 마켓); qualify each segment only when its own market list contains KRW.
parser_contract.pattern_B: Exactly one NAME(SYMBOL) plus one separate parenthesized MARKET-LIST containing 마켓; pair them only when there is exactly one symbol candidate.

binance_route.preexistence_proof: First timestamp only from event-month archive; if necessary, first timestamp only from immediately previous monthly archive. OHLCV fields remain forbidden in Source Gate.

event_universe.event_selection: chronologically first qualifying Upbit KRW-support announcement per exact symbol within 2023-2024

strategy_prefreeze.signal_time: official Upbit announcement listed_at converted to UTC
strategy_prefreeze.entry: open of first complete Binance 1m bar whose open_time is >= signal_time + 5 minutes
strategy_prefreeze.gap_stop_fill: next observable bar open if it is already below stop; otherwise stop price
strategy_prefreeze.gap_target_fill: target price; never a more favorable gap fill
strategy_prefreeze.time_exit: close of last complete 1m bar in the 360-minute hold window
